Approved in the EU.
Approved in the US.
US food use is subject to the listed CFR provisions and their conditions, checked in 2026.
more_info.overview: Acetic acid is used as a preservative in food. Its technological role is to help limit microbial spoilage.
more_info.uses: EU permissions include unripened cheese excluding products falling in category 16, whey cheese, canned or bottled fruit and vegetables, bread prepared solely with the following ingredients: wheat flour, water, yeast or leaven,  salt. These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
